experiment: matched-number hook (7 shots before half-time, 0 after), 2-row compare as beat 1, nine-game winless run as the story, ~30 s
fan_question: Is this a real turning point for Carrick's United, or just one good half?

beats.say: Seven Roma shots before half-time. Zero after.
United flipped it. Five shots before the break, ten after. All three goals came in the second half.
From a team with nine games without a win. Two-nil down at home, coach under pressure.
My pick, Matheus Cunha. Two goals in three minutes, eighty-three and eighty-six. Then a second yellow.
